Settings

Simple focuses on daily logging and progress. Advanced keeps the full Recovery Tracker toolkit (inventory, detailed insights, custom columns, data health).

Advanced / More

These stay available anytime. Switch to Advanced Mode for the full navigation, or open them here.

Current theme: Dark

Auto: follows screen size. Phone: always uses compact mobile layout. Laptop: always uses wide desktop layout.

100%

Enter a value from 75 to 200.

App zoom 100 percent

Zoom scales the whole interface (navigation, forms, tables, modals, and text), not just font size. Phone and Laptop views remember their own zoom when you change it while that view is active.

Optional bars under supported values (inventory remaining, taper vs plan, spending vs budget, purchase limits, streak/lifespan/nicotine-free goals). Numeric values stay visible. Bars use conditional-rule colors when a rule matches. A target marker appears on the bar when the target falls within the displayed range.

Target lines show current vs plan/goal/cap with difference and percent of target. Favorable direction depends on the metric (lower is better for use and spending; higher for streaks and lifespan). Default green / amber / red tones apply when no matching conditional color rule exists; custom rules always override. Labels are never invented.

Comparisons respect the selected substance and shared date filter, reuse normalized metrics, and skip % change when the previous value is zero. Custom date ranges compare to the immediately preceding range of the same length. Conditional rules can target previous value, numeric change, % change, or direction.

Color Rule Manager

Central place to manage all conditional color rules. Rules change appearance only — never your data. Status labels are optional and are never invented automatically for charts, rows, cards, badges, or tables.

Edit rule

Hold Ctrl/Cmd to select multiple. Choose “All sections” alone to apply everywhere.

Enter duration in hours. Decimals are allowed.

Labels stay optional. Nothing is auto-added to charts, rows, cards, badges, or tables.

Leave empty for no background override. Accepts #RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, rgb(), rgba().
